body.statement: Remarks 2.1 and 2.3 of Yu, Shi, and Tchetgen Tchetgen's cited preprint display a thirteen-element spanning list for the no-baseline, two-ternary-proxy fortified space, a twelve-element spanning list for the demand space after taking the latent variable binary, and a \(12\times15\) matrix whose supply columns are formed by adjoining only the constant and linear complement-proxy functions to the displayed fortified list.

source.verbatim_statement: the matrix \(M \in \mathbb R^{12 \times 15}\) is full rank

attestation.note: Transcribed from Remark 2.3 of the arXiv v2 TeX source. Remark 2.1 lists thirteen fortified spanning functions; Remark 2.3 lists twelve demand spanning functions and specifies the supply columns as the first list together with \(\{1,Z_2\}\).
